We have cleverly concealed that information on the sign outside, the blinking apparatus that reads <tt>NINGAL'S DROID REPAIR</tt>.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], visiting the shop while in disguise, and the shop owner|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>}}
'''Ningal's Droid Repair''' was a shop located on [[Vannix]]. It specialized in the maintenance and repair of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], including [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]].

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once brought [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to this shop under false pretenses while being followed by covert Vannix agents, in order to pass on falsified information embedded in R2's memory. R2-D2 feigned a personality malfunction in which he was incapable of conversing without unleashing a stream of insults.

As of [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the shop was run by an aged [[Human/Legends|Human]] male with a sarcastic attitude. He did not accept [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and insisted on bartering for [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]].
